latestVersion.changelog:
Twitch Highlight Editor v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate AI-powered Twitch stream highlight reels from raw uploads (MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI up to 500MB)
- No editing skills required: just describe the clips you want, and receive highlight reels in 1–3 minutes
- Automatic backend session and token management for a seamless workflow
- Cloud rendering pipeline delivers high-quality 1080p MP4 exports
- Supports direct file uploads, credit tracking, job status monitoring, and common request routing via chat prompts
